Profile

About

AWS DevOps Engineer with 3.3 years of experience designing, automating, and managing cloud infrastructure on AWS. I build CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub Actions, provision infrastructure with Terraform, and deploy containerized applications on Amazon EKS using Docker and Kubernetes.

I work closely with production support and incident management — running Root Cause Analysis, applying Infrastructure as Code, and keeping systems observable with Prometheus, Grafana, and Amazon CloudWatch. Security and quality gates (SonarQube, Trivy) are built into every pipeline I own, as part of a broader DevSecOps approach.

3.3 Years AWS DevOps CI/CD Automation Kubernetes / Amazon EKS Docker Terraform Jenkins GitHub Actions Ansible Infrastructure as Code Production Support Monitoring DevSecOps
